purpose: LRM 4.6.4.2 flicker_noise: the PSD falls as 1/f^exponent

oracle.derivation: dec 1 from 1 to 100: points 1, 10, 100. The only generator is the model's flicker_noise(1e-18, 2.0) across out-0, S_I = 1e-18/f^2 A^2/Hz (Rs is a SPICE resistor with noisy=0, so its 4kT/R stays out and the generator is isolated; the model's V/1000 contribution is noiseless; Vin is a small-signal short). It sees Rs||r = 500 ohm, so onoise(f) = 500*sqrt(1e-18/f^2) = 5e-7/f V/sqrt(Hz): 5e-7, 5e-8, 5e-9. An exponent of 1 instead of 2 gives 5e-7/sqrt(f) and fails at 10 and 100 Hz.
